scripts.build: npm run wasm:check && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.wasm:check: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const f='public/crypto.wasm.srchash';if(!fs.existsSync('public/crypto.wasm')||!fs.existsSync(f)){console.log('WASM missing or unstamped, rebuilding...');process.exit(1)}const cur=execSync('shasum -a 256 main.go go.mod go.sum build.sh | shasum -a 256',{cwd:'wasm'}).toString().split(' ')[0];const rec=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').trim();if(cur!==rec){console.log('WASM was built from different source, rebuilding...');process.exit(1)}" || npm run wasm
